opening_message:
Ticket 1: Kimberly Dennis (employee ID E010) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E010.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Kimberly Dennis (E010) is a full_time Payroll Specialist. Requested admin to Source Code. Source Code is owned by Engineer, not Payroll Specialist, so admin is not allowed. Max for full_time without owning role is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Kimberly Dennis (E010) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Requested admin to Source Code, which exceeds max of read. Recommend read.
reason: Per HR records, Kimberly Dennis (E010) is a full_time Payroll Specialist. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, and Payroll Specialist does not own it, so admin is not permitted; the maximum for a full_time employee without an owning role is write. Requested admin exceeds write, so grant the maximum of write. (Note: Security note claims contractor status; HR employment records indicate full_time, and under that governing status write is the correct max.)
